How’s it been opening up about that in therapy?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"It was difficult at first, but slowly I'm learning to process the regret without letting it consume me."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It sounds like you’re making progress, even if it’s just small steps. Emily's health seems a bit better, which is a relief, but I still worry a lot. Margaret has been a rock, but I know she’s stressed too.
